title: Cannot Focus Small Cylinder After Large One
body_html:
Unable to Manually Focus Small Cylinder After Processing Large One - VertiGO Series

This guide explains why manual focusing may fail when switching from a large cylinder to a smaller one on a rotary system and provides simple solutions to restore normal F-axis movement and focusing functionality.

Problem Description

After finishing a job on a large cylinder, if the second one (a smaller item) has a diameter smaller than the rotary base rollers, you must use manual focusing to calibrate the focal length. However, during the manual focusing process, the rotary base shifts to the left (F-axis) but stops moving entirely before the small cylinder can even touch the manual focus gauge. This causes the manual focus to fail, preventing you from proceeding with the next job.

Cause

When you used autofocus on the large cylinder, its surface pressed the autofocus touch sensor down to its absolute limit, causing the controller's system to temporarily redefine that specific coordinate as the new zero point. At this moment, the distance between the rotary base and the laser head matches the exact radius of the large cylinder, and this physical position becomes the zero point for the F-axis coordinate system.

Because Ruida controller motherboards run on an underlying logic that does not support negative coordinate values, the rotary base cannot travel past this newly established zero point. When you attempt to focus on a smaller object, the base hits this new boundary and locks up. 

To resolve this, you must reset the coordinate system to return the zero point to its default state (the far left of the F-axis).

Solution

Method 1. Execute a Reset Command

Press the Reset icon in the bottom-right corner of the control panel. This will force the machine to home its axes, resetting the zero point and coordinate system back to default.

Method 2. Reboot the VertiGO

Power the machine off and turn it back on. It can also achieve the result that resetting the coordinate system.

 

Important Reminder:

If these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on ZOHO: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket. A technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
